newsitem.title: USA: Valero restarts Houston refinery FCC after repairs.
newsitem.headline: Valero restarts Houston refinery FCC after repairs.

text.p: Valero Energy Corp as expected restarted Thursday the 61,000 barrel per day (bpd) fluid catalytic cracking unit at its Houston refinery after 10 days of repairs, a Valero spokesman said Friday.
He said the repairs included a "mini turnaround" on the unit that will enable the company to delay further planned maintenance on the cracker until 1999 from 1998 previously.
"It's up and running," said Valero spokesman Keith Booke.
Valero took the unit down last week on Monday after an expander in the FCC unit began to vibrate.
The Houston plant, which has crude distillation capacity of 85,000 bpd, is one of the three Valero bought from Salomon Inc's Basis Petroleum unit earlier this spring.
((-- Oliver Ludwig, New York Energy Desk, 1 212 859 1633))
